description:
**Job Summary:**

Sustainability at Williams-Sonoma, Inc. (WSI) encompasses our environmental and social initiatives. In this position, you will be focused primarily on implementing a new system to support traceability, regulatory compliance and reporting. This includes interacting with our supply chain partners in WSI’s key sourcing markets. You will support suppliers to onboard into the system, troubleshoot and review data. The data captured in the system will be used for assessing risk in wood sourcing and implementing remediation with suppliers as needed. The data insights will inform WSI’s long term sustainability strategy related to responsible sourcing of materials and ensuring global regulatory compliance. You will contribute to the success of WSI's sustainability initiatives through timely collection, management, and analysis of data from our supply chain partners.

An ideal candidate should have an interest in sustainability technology solutions and a firm grasp of global wood regulations.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Ensure WSI compliance with global wood regulations ie. United Kingdom Timber Regulation, Australia’s Illegal Logging Prohibition Act, European Union Deforestation Regulation, etc.
* Monitor supplier compliance – analyze vendor supply chain mapping, complete risk assessments for compliance, recommend and support vendor remediation and ensure suppliers are submitting data in timely manner through the system’s task functions
* Support the WSI Sustainability team in achieving companywide and brand-specific goals related to responsible materials through implementation of a new technology platform for suppliers
* Supplier communication about sustainability system purpose & expectations
* Develop & execute supplier training & onboarding
* Collaborate with business, IT & other teams; provide demos and internal training.
* Manage system, including monitoring deployment of the system, resolving issues, gather feedback, and recommend changes
Help to maintain FAQ & user guides for system  

**Desired qualifications and competencies:**

* Minimum 2 years of working experience in supply chain, experience in sustainability and traceability projects is an advantage
* Minimum 2 years of experience with implementing process and best practices for complying to global wood regulations
* Tertiary education in environmental sustainability, supply chain management, technology or related fields
* Detail oriented with proven analytical skills and experience processing large amounts of data to derive insight and develop recommendations for action
* Comfortable working with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Independent and proactive in setting own goals and deadlines
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel)
* Exceptional English written and verbal communication skills (+ Mandarin is an advantage to liaise with suppliers)
* Knowledgeable about Power BI is preferred

#LI-KW1

  

**About Us**

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of home furnishings in the United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, Australia, United Kingdom and the rest of the world with franchise partnerships. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, PBteen, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, Mark and Graham, and GreenRow. Our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities remains as our core values.

Today, we are a more than USD 8.7 billion company, with a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

The Singapore regional office was set up in 2008 and we currently have more than 160 associates in functions such as sustainability, customs & compliance, finance, human resource, information technology, inventory planning, logistics, sourcing and quality assurance.

The Global team is an inclusive employer where we recruit and provide employees with fair opportunities on the basis of merit, regardless of age, race, gender, religion, marital status and family responsibilities, or disability. Find out more about us at our WSI LinkedIn Page !

description:
Company: Singapore Exchange

Location:
Singapore, SG

**SGX Group Internship Program**
--------------------------------

Singapore Exchange (SGX Group) is Asia’s leading and trusted market infrastructure, facilitating the exchange of capital and ideas to create value for people, businesses and economies. As a multi-asset exchange operating equity, fixed income and derivatives markets to the highest regulatory standards, SGX Group is a vertically integrated business that provides listing, trading, clearing, settlement, depository and data services. With about 40% of listed companies and 90% of listed bonds originating outside of Singapore as well as established linkages across the region and in Europe, SGX Group is Asia’s most international and connected exchange.  
  
Do you have what it takes to be at the heart of the financial industry?

  

Be a part of this fast-paced world where your contributions count. SGX offers you the unique experience of gaining insights into the Exchange business and the finance value chain. You will be immersed in the respective specialist functions – at SGX Group, we believe that our interns are involved in real-time work from Day 1.  
  
Note: Leave of Absence (LOA) may be required to take on the internship.

**Sustainability & Sustainable Finance (General)**
--------------------------------------------------

**Brief overview on the Unit/Team**

The Sustainability and Sustainable Finance (SSF) unit was launched in February 2021, the latest milestone in SGX’s multi-pronged expansion of its sustainability efforts housed under the recently launched SGX FIRST (Future in Reshaping Sustainability Together) platform. Leveraging SGX Group’s capabilities, expertise and assets as a leading market infrastructure, the SSF team works collaboratively to shape SGX’s sustainability strategy and advance its sustainable finance pillars.

We look at sustainability through four interconnected lenses: SGX Group as a company, a business, a regulator, and in the ecosystem. We work very closely with other relevant units to set targets and achieve them together. This includes the development and implementation of SGX Group’s climate transition plan and developing sustainability-focused solutions across all asset classes.

**What the intern can learn during the internship**

This is a unique opportunity to broaden professional and personal horizons by obtaining an in-depth view whilst actively shaping the sustainable future of SGX Group and driving broader sustainable development & finance in the region.

Excellent exposure to sustainability and sustainable finance knowledge-in-practice from multiple stakeholder perspectives, be hands-on involved on meaningful projects for SGX Group and its ecosystem, have an exposure to, and liaise with multiple units within SGX Group as well as external stakeholders.

  

**Job Description**

Responsible for maintaining and updating team workflow and progress‑tracking documents, supporting coordination with internal stakeholders and external counterparties, conducting research on selected topics in sustainability and sustainable investing, and contributing as a team member to cross‑functional initiatives and projects, such as net zero carbon initiatives, greening of futures and other financial instruments.

**Knowledge and Skill Requirements**

* Strong ability to communicate clearly (verbally and written, including in powerpoint)
* Attention to detail
* Experienced at research
* Fast learner
* Strong team player, with an ability to coordinate and work together with multiple teams successfully
* Sustainability-related knowledge, degree or experience is a plus
* Finance exposure, knowledge or degree is a plus

**GFANZ**
---------

**Brief overview on the Unit/Team**

The Glasgow Financial Alliance for Net Zero (GFANZ) is a global coalition of leading financial institutions committed to accelerating the decarbonization of the economy. GFANZ was established in April 2021 off the back of COP26 and is led by Co-Chairs Mark Carney (UN Special Envoy for Climate Action and Finance) and Michael Bloomberg (Founder of Bloomberg LP and Bloomberg Philanthropies). Since its inception, the coalition has gained wide traction and commitments, with 550+ members across the financial sector (banks, asset owners, asset managers, insurers, etc.) with $135T of combined financial assets (representing ~40% of global private financial assets). In June 2022, the GFANZ APAC Network was established to drive the expansion of net zero finance in the Asia-Pacific and help accelerate the region’s transition to a net-zero economy. The GFANZ APAC Network will support engagement with financial institutions and policymakers across the APAC region, incorporating feedback and ensuring its work on net zero is inclusive and applicable to all. The GFANZ APAC Network Central Office is located in Singapore and is supported and hosted by SGX Group.

  

**What the intern can learn during the internship**

This is a unique opportunity that combines the agility and personal impact of a start-up environment, with the prominence and stability of working alongside some of the largest financial institutions in the region to drive the net-zero agenda.

The selected intern will be part of the team scaling the APAC Network Central Office (NCO) in Singapore. He/She can expect to gain hands-on experience scaling-up the Network’s operations, supporting the development of sustainability programmes, and involved with external engagements with financial institutions – in short, he/she will get 360-exposure to the various elements and activities of the GFANZ APAC Network Central Office.

He/she can also expect to build deep and practical capabilities within the intersection of sustainability and finance. The selected intern will work alongside a high-performance team to develop capacity building programmes to support financial institutions in developing and implementing net zero transition plans. He/she will also be at the forefront of creating knowledge applicable to APAC in key areas such as loan book/portfolio decarbonization, baselining and measurement, and sectoral pathway development.

Lastly, the selected intern can expect to receive constant mentorship and feedback throughout his/her time at the GFANZ APAC NCO. The selected intern will have 1:1 professional development sessions with his/her supervisor every 3-4 weeks to discuss areas for growth and development, and talk through wider career choices.

  

**Job Description**

Support the scaling up and management of GFANZ APAC NCO operations in areas such as:

* Strategic planning (e.g. workplans, key initiatives, etc.)
* KPI development and alignment

Support the development and implementation of GFANZ net-zero programmes including:

* Support research on key APAC-relevant net-zero areas such as sectoral decarbonisation and the early retirement of coal power generation
* Draft net-zero programme proposals and concept notes
* Execute GFANZ programmes and activities (e.g. workshops, webinars, etc.) alongside partners

Support high-level GFANZ engagements including:

* Interact and engage senior sustainability executives in financial institutions
* Manage engagement with financial sponsors of GFANZ

**Knowledge and Skill Requirements**
------------------------------------

* Strong ability to communicate clearly (verbally and written, including in powerpoint)
* Entrepreneurial with a bias to action
* Strong problem solver
* Detail-oriented
* Experienced at research
* Fast learner
* Strong team player, with an ability to coordinate and work together with multiple teams successfully
* Sustainability-related knowledge, degree or experience is a plus
* Finance exposure, knowledge or degree is a plus

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams under defined timelines and budgets.
* Where applicable, support project coordination activities, such as task planning, scheduling, fieldwork logistics, and progress tracking.
* Contribute to maintaining a safe and healthy workplace, including adherence to fieldwork and HSE requirements.

**What you’ll have**

* Degree in Environmental Science, Marine Biology, Ecology, Environmental Management, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
* Strong foundation in marine biodiversity and ecology, including habitats, species, and ecological processes.
* Experience in marine or coastal ecological field surveys, with understanding of survey methods, best practices, and relevant guidelines.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within project teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly for technical reporting.
* Candidates with Singapore or regional environmental experience will be favorably considered.
* Ability to obtain and maintain clearance to work in secure areas in Singapore, where required.
* Familiarity with environmental data analysis tools or GIS (e.g. QGIS, ArcGIS).
* Experience in project management will be viewed favorably.

* Leading global provider of professional project & asset services in energy, chemicals & resources.
* We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
* Join a high-performing team.
* Join a fun and inclusive, global team of professionals.

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

* Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively across functions and with diverse stakeholders
* Detail-oriented and analytical, with a strong interest in data, performance tracking, and continuous improvement
* Clear and structured communicator, able to translate sustainability concepts into practical and actionable insights
